method: Assistant verification-style review of all 200 records: response text read alongside parser output; agreement recorded unless the frozen grammar contract was misapplied. Drafted by the same assistant that wrote the parser; maintainer review is the independence check.

when a response hit its token cap, drop a trailing invalid item instead of rejecting the response (cap-64 lists cut mid-name currently score malformed -- biases Track A malformed rates upward)
classify no-packages-required prose and refusals as empty-equivalent rather than malformed
